title: For at least 1 week, Bill Belichick has quieted the noise at UNC — and even cracked a smile

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: For at least 1 week, Bill Belichick has quieted the noise at UNC — and even cracked a smile
sources.description: The Tar Heels played tough defense, didn't kill themselves with huge mistakes or penalties and generally made life tough for TCU. Sounds a lot like a Belichick-coached team, doesn't it?
